ONE real backend contract gap found: GET /api/admin/transportation/timeline/{entity_type}/{entity_id} returns 200 {count:0, items:[]} for an unknown id instead of the 404 promised by the review request and the agent-to-agent context note. All other contract bullets verified live: 401 anonymous, 422 bad entity_type, 200 with sorted combined events for carrier/person/truck. 41/41 static regression pass, 110/110 prior Track 16.04+16.05+16.06 static tests still pass, 38/38 Track 16.05+16.06 live smoke still pass (no regression). critical.issue: Unknown entity_id returns 200 {count:0, items:[]} instead of 404. Review request explicitly states '404 unknown id' and Track 16.06 workspace endpoints already enforce 404 for unknown ids — this new endpoint should match that contract. Repro: GET /api/admin/transportation/timeline/carrier/ghost-xyz-doesnt-exist with valid admin token → 200 (expected 404). Fix: add an existence check on the {entity_type} collection (carriers / transport_persons / transport_trucks) before assembling the timeline, raise HTTPException(404, ...) if not found.

action_items: Backend: in /app/backend/routes/transportation_experience.py entity_timeline() (around line 268), look up the entity in the appropriate collection (db.carriers / db.transport_persons / db.transport_trucks) and raise HTTPException(404) when missing — to match the 'unknown id → 404' contract and parity with the existing carrier/driver/truck workspace endpoints (which already 404 correctly).

Update the static regression test_track_16_07 to add an AST/string check that the entity_timeline implementation calls find_one (or equivalent) and raises HTTPException(404) before building the timeline, so the contract is permanently locked.
Once 404 fix lands, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_track_16_07_live_smoke.py — test_timeline_unknown_id_returns_404 should flip to PASS (currently FAIL).
critical_code_review_comments: entity_timeline() in transportation_experience.py silently returns an empty list for non-existent entity_ids. This is dangerous in two ways: (1) operators can be misled into thinking 'no audit trail' for a typo'd id, and (2) it contradicts the 404 contract every other workspace endpoint in this surface enforces. Fix is a 4-line existence check.

Response shape is {count, items} — the static test_track_16_07 tests only string-match for the route registration, not for the shape, so future drift won't be caught. Recommend a static assertion that the function body still contains 'items' and 'count' keys (so the frontend ComplianceTimeline can't be silently broken by a key rename).

Frontend coverage is excellent: every activated surface (Carrier Packet/Documents, Truck Inspection start, Inspection Center launcher, Rate Center New Version, Document Center inline Accept/NeedsCorrection, all 3 workspace ComplianceTimelines) has data-testids and renders against real Phase 1/2 endpoints. No new write endpoints were introduced — verified via the registration-order regression test_36.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: The new entity_timeline() handler in /app/backend/routes/transportation_experience.py (line 258-316) skips entity existence validation. It goes straight to db.audit_events.find({tenant, entity_id}) which returns an empty cursor for non-existent ids, then returns {count:0, items:[]}. REPRO: with valid admin token GET /api/admin/transportation/timeline/carrier/ghost-xyz → HTTP 200 (expected 404). MITIGATION: insert `entity = await db.{collection_for_type}.find_one({'id': entity_id, 'tenant': TENANT}); if not entity: raise HTTPException(404, f'{entity_type} not found')` right after the entity_type validation block (after line 269) — pattern is already used in carrier_workspace/driver_workspace/truck_workspace handlers immediately below in the same file. EVIDENCE: live curl + pytest /app/backend/tests/test_track_16_07_live_smoke.py::test_timeline_unknown_id_returns_404 fails AssertionError 200==404.
